meta: Part 4 of "Your own AI assistant". In part 3, each task got its own room (project) with its own document shelf. This video turns that shelf into a helper that looks things up and cites pages.
prompt: Use only this document. What does error E21 mean, and how do I fix it? Give the page number.

muc.title: A document shelf that answers
muc.text: Last time, each task got its own room with its own document shelf. Now let's turn that shelf into a helper that looks things up for you.

muc.title: Thick documents, small questions
muc.text: Your company handbook is eighty pages, and you just want to know how many days off you get. Flipping through it takes all morning.

muc.title: Ask the document directly
muc.text: Put the document in a project and ask directly. AI finds the right section, as we saw in the last series, and answers with the page number.

muc.title: Three places to use it today
muc.text: It works right away with company handbooks, manuals for things at home, or your kid's school rules.

muc.title: Always double-check
muc.text: The golden rule: make AI give the page number, and open it to check anything important. If it's not in the document, AI must say so.

muc.title: Ask the user manual
muc.text: Upload the manual for something in your home, ask how to fix an error, and ask for the page number.

muc.title: What if it worked every week by itself?
muc.text: Your assistant is good now, but it still waits for you to ask. Part five lets it do weekly work on its own.
